summary: Pre-market 2026-11-03: the risk score is 66.75, still high_risk, and the regime sits at risk_off for a second day — set by breadth at 0.3355 breaking the 0.35 gate, not by volatility, since VIX is 19.42 and far from the 28 trigger. The 0.30 gain on yesterday's post-market read of 66.45 is data catch-up, not a new market signal: the dollar leg caught up from its 2026-10-23 print of 121.3202 to the 2026-10-30 print of 121.6656, lifting the macro dimension from 71.74 to 72.92 for a 0.236 contribution, with equity structure adding 0.068 and liquidity and credit giving back 0.010. Monday's US close extended the AI-hardware de-rating: the semiconductor ETF fell 3.7878 percent, AMD 7.5198 percent, Micron 5.7814 percent, networking 6.6295 percent and AI infrastructure 6.0846 percent, yet SPY lost only 0.4790 percent — the damage stayed locked inside the compute chain. Asia then supplied the other half: all 11 tracked A-shares fell, averaging 7.5377 percent with 1 at limit-down, and those same names had already lost between 26.0773 and 45.5805 percent over the past month — capitulation inside an existing downtrend, not a new shock. Memory and optical names are drawing buyers again pre-market; the real variable today is AMD's report after the close.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation held at 0.75 for a contribution of 11.25 points, the heaviest block in the model: 6 of 8 scoring legs fired — SPY down 0.4790 percent, the dollar index at 121.6656, the real rate at 2.60, bitcoin down 0.33437 percent, small-cap underperformance on a 63-session basis at 4.9876 and copper down 2.2389 percent. The 2 idle legs are gold (down 0.6273 percent, short of the up-condition) and high-yield OAS (3.44, still below 4.0). This is multi-point confirmation, not one noisy leg.

Breadth is the direct regime trigger: the share of constituents above their 200-day average is 0.3355 (52 of 155), a dimension risk score of 81.45 and a 4.9578-point contribution; the new-low ratio has risen to 0.4076 (64 of 157) against a new-high ratio of only 0.0318 (5 names). Semis relative strength is 13.8401 behind on a 63-session basis, so this is not single-day noise.

High-yield OAS is 3.44, at the 87.88th percentile of its own history, for a 7.0304-point contribution; investment-grade OAS is 0.94 with a risk score of 77.14. Credit is genuinely widening (OAS from 3.26 to 3.44) but the absolute level is still below the 4.0 trigger, so that leg has not fired — the main reason the score has not pushed through 70.

The 10-year real rate is 2.60, in the 97.43rd percentile, for a 4.8715-point contribution; the nominal 10-year is 4.94, in the 97.11th percentile and slightly below its prior 4.98. The dollar index at 121.6656 sits in the 65.68th percentile — real rates and the dollar are both elevated, so the discount-rate pressure on long-duration growth has never lifted.

Monday's de-rating was structural: the semiconductor ETF fell 3.7878 percent, AI infrastructure 6.0846 percent, networking 6.6295 percent, AMD 7.5198 percent and data centres 3.2657 percent. The memory row needs a caveat: its 4.5878 is only the 2 Korean memory names, while the 6 US memory stocks averaged 6.4117 percent — the true US memory decline is not what the published row shows.

supporting_signals.claim: Semis relative strength is 13.8401 behind on a 63-session basis with a dimension risk score of 80.12, and the semis sector row fell 3.9357 percent on the day. The underperformance is cumulative, not a single-session jump.

All 11 tracked A-shares fell, averaging 7.5377 percent with a median decline of 6.9990 percent; 300223.SZ was worst at 11.9469 percent and 301308.SZ best at 5.7914 percent. This is a settled single-session close, not an intraday snapshot.

Copper fell 2.2389 percent, one of the few real-economy demand signals moving with equities, while the dollar index at 121.6656 in the 65.68th percentile keeps financial conditions tight for emerging markets and commodities.

contradicting_signals.claim: Realized volatility is only 11.3068 with a risk score of 15.23, the healthiest reading of the 6 dimensions, and VIX at 19.42 is far below the 28 regime trigger. Prices are falling but volatility is not disorderly.

The memory complex is drawing buyers again pre-market: the CLS relay reports SanDisk, Micron, Western Digital and SK Hynix all rebounding before the open. If that holds into the session, yesterday's 6.4117 percent memory decline may prove to be an overshoot. The Chinese source is an RSSHub relay — second-hand aggregation, not a first-party statement.

At the index level this is still a narrow de-rating: SPY lost only 0.4790 percent while Tesla rose 1.003 percent, fintech 1.8258 percent and autos 1.0030 percent, and 6 of the 22 rows were positive. Money is rotating between blocks, not leaving outright.

what_changed_today: The total score is 66.75, 0.30 above yesterday's post-market 66.45. Decomposition: macro 0.236, equity structure 0.068, liquidity and credit -0.010 — 0.294 in total.

Almost all of the gain is data catch-up rather than a new tape: the macro dollar indicator moved from its 2026-10-23 print of 121.3202 to the 2026-10-30 print of 121.6656, lifting its percentile from 60.96 to 65.68. It was the only macro sub-indicator to move; the other 3 sum to 226.00 and did not change.
The regime is risk_off for a second day, again on breadth at 0.3355 below the 0.35 gate; VIX at 19.42 is below 28, so volatility played no part in the call.

Three rows of the 11-02 US session were rewritten overnight: memory went from 6.4117 percent at 21:34Z yesterday to 4.5878 percent, consumer_electronics from 1.9966 percent to 0.2059 percent, and ev_supply_chain from 1.3538 percent to 0.1119 percent. No US price changed — the Asia leg took over the final step. Cite those 3 only with the session attached.

The A-share close confirms all 11 names down, averaging 7.5377 percent with a median decline of 6.9990 percent; 300223.SZ was worst at 11.9469 percent and 001309.SZ closed limit-down at 10.0010 percent, after a prior session averaging a 1.4932 percent gain — a full direction reversal in one session.
Rates, credit and VIX vintages still stop at 2026-10-30, so the model holds no 11-02 rate or volatility close; RRP and SOFR have advanced to 2026-11-02. Read VIX 19.42 as last Friday's print.
watch_next: AMD reports after today's close with consensus EPS of 1.95 (FMP calendar). The stock fell 7.5198 percent on Monday and 26.1037 percent over the past month — expectations are already low, so the real variable is management's framing of 2027 capital spending.
Today is US midterm election day, with JOLTS job openings at 15:00Z. A single-party sweep could reprice equities, Treasury yields and energy at the same time.
The breadth gate is 0.35 and the reading is 0.3355 (52 of 155); the regime only leaves risk_off above 0.35, and new lows have already widened to 64 names.

High-yield OAS at 3.44 is 0.56 away from the 4.0 trigger. Crossing it would lift cross-asset confirmation from 6 of 8 to 7 of 8 and the dimension from 75 to 87.5, mechanically adding 1.875 points to the total.
The Employment Situation lands on Friday 11-06 and CPI on 11-10, both high importance; with the 10-year real rate at 2.60 in the 97.43rd percentile, discount-rate shocks get amplified.

A-share semis follow-through: 300475.SZ is down 45.5805 percent over the past month and 301308.SZ 35.1216 percent. If tomorrow does not extend the decline, local leverage is being cleared; if it does, the risk-appetite gap transmits from Asia back into US equities.

bull_case.title: Bull case: a narrow de-rating, breadth repairs first
points: The index level is intact: SPY lost only 0.4790 percent, 6 of the 22 rows were positive, with fintech up 1.8258 percent, industrial automation 1.4065 percent and autos 1.0030 percent. Money is rotating between blocks rather than leaving.

Credit has not confirmed: high-yield OAS at 3.44 is still below 4.0 and investment grade at 0.94, while realized volatility is 11.3068 for a risk score of only 15.23. In a credit event these 2 move first.

Memory and optical names are rebounding together pre-market, which suggests the marginal seller in the de-rating is thinning; if AMD holds its guidance, the compute chain has the setup for a technical repair.
The dollar index slipped from 121.7361 to 121.6656; if the dollar has peaked, the pressure from a 2.60 real rate eases first.

base_case.title: Base case: sideways inside high_risk, breadth decides the regime
points: The score oscillates between 60 and 70 while the AI-hardware de-rating continues but stays inside the compute chain; risk_off only lifts once breadth at 0.3355 repairs.
AMD's report is today's hinge: consensus EPS of 1.95 is already low, so the real variable is the wording on 2027 capital spending.
The Asian selloff needs US confirmation to escalate: if a 7.5377 percent average A-share decline finds no echo after the US open, it stays a regional leverage clearing.

bear_case.title: Bear case: credit widens as AMD misses and breadth collapses again
points: High-yield OAS only has to travel from 3.44 to 4.0 for cross-asset confirmation to go from 6 of 8 to 7 of 8 and the dimension from 75 to 87.5, mechanically adding 1.875 points to the total.
New lows have expanded from 61 to 64 names (ratio 0.4076) against only 5 new highs (0.0318); an AMD miss would deepen the 13.8401 semis relative underperformance.
The A-share semiconductor decline may not be finished: 300475.SZ is down 45.5805 percent over the month and 301308.SZ 35.1216 percent, with 3 names sitting at the bottom of their one-year range.
Copper down 2.2389 percent alongside a 2.60 real rate flags both demand and discount pressure; a dollar index back above 121.7361 would tighten financial conditions another notch.
